payload.artist_html: E. L. Stanley, K. L Fenner, J. D. Daza, M. P. Heinicke, J. S. Arias & D. W. Krause
payload.credit_html: "New insights into the phylogenetic position and palaeobiogeography of Konkasaurus mahalana (Squamata: Scincoidea) from the Late Cretaceous of Madagascar"
payload.description_html: Figure S1. Standardized views of the skull and pelvic bones of Konkasaurus mahalana. A) Left postdentary elements, from top to bottom: labial, ventral, dorsal, and lingual views. B) Left dentary, from top to bottom: labial, ventral, dorsal, and lingual views. Insert of replacement tooth showing bicuspid (faintly tricuspid) teeth. C) Left maxilla, clockwise from top left: lingual, Dorsal, ventral, and rostral views. D) Left ilium, from left to right: medial and lateral views. E) Left ischium, from left to right: medial and lateral views. F) Right ischium, from left to right: medial and lateral views. G) phalanx. Abbreviations: add.fs = adductor fossa, ait = anterior illiac tubercle, cd = crista dentalis, cor.fac = coronoid facet of articular, dent.fac = dental facet of articular, act = acetabulum, mc = meckelian canal, pap = postarticular process, pff = prefrontal facet, sds = subdental shelf, spl.fac = splenial facet of articular.
